data.title: Simpleads vs Lusha: Full Pipeline vs Chrome-Extension Contact Reveal
data.intro:
Lusha is built around a simple, effective core: a Chrome extension that reveals verified emails and direct dials while you browse LinkedIn or a company website, backed by a 300M+ contact database. Simpleads is built differently — a guided pipeline where you filter first (title, seniority, company, hiring signals) and then export a scored list, rather than revealing contacts one profile at a time.
Independent testing has also flagged a real gap between Lusha's claimed accuracy and its actual lookup coverage — in one March 2026 test of 300 B2B contacts, Lusha returned an email for only 31% of lookups, even though the emails it did find were accurate. That's a coverage problem, not just an accuracy one, and it's worth factoring into a credit-based pricing decision.

data.title: Contact Discovery: Filter-First vs. Reveal-One-at-a-Time
data.content: The two tools solve the “who do I contact” problem in fundamentally different orders.

columns.title: Simpleads
items: Set People Search filters (title, seniority, contact status) once
Get a full filtered list with a Live Estimator showing size before you commit
No per-contact credit spend just to see if a lookup will succeed

columns.title: Lusha
items: Reveal contacts one at a time via the Chrome extension while browsing
Credits spent per successful reveal — unsuccessful lookups still cost time
Independent testing found only 31% of lookups returned an email at all

items.a: Yes — Simpleads covers the same core need (finding verified B2B contacts) through a filter-first pipeline rather than a one-at-a-time Chrome-extension reveal.

items.q: How accurate is Lusha's contact data compared to Simpleads?
items.a: Independent testing in March 2026 found Lusha returned an email for only 31% of 300 lookups, though the emails it did find were largely accurate. Simpleads' People Search lets you filter by verified Email/Phone status before exporting, rather than paying credits per lookup attempt.

items.q: Does Lusha offer hiring-signal data like Simpleads?
items.a: No — Lusha's core product is contact reveal and database lookup; it doesn't include a built-in job-posting cross-reference feature.

items.q: Which is cheaper, Simpleads or Lusha?
items.a: Lusha's credit-based pricing runs $37-$300/user/month depending on tier and credit volume. Simpleads uses plan-based pricing with clear monthly limits — compare current rates on each pricing page for your specific usage pattern.
